To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
zyxin is able to interact with the Hedgehog (HH) receptor Patched2 (PTC2) in the cytoplasm of Xenopus laevs.
zyxin interacts directly with the Hh receptor Ptc2, and this interaction is determined by the second LIM domains of zyxin and by the C-terminal cyto-plasmic juxta-membrane region of Ptc2.
zyxin is a novel regulator of the Hh pathway.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of cytoskeletal proteins in the regulation of signaling pathways.
the role of zykin in the regulation of the Hedgehog signaling pathway.
the role of cytoskeletal protein in the regulation of the activity of a transmembrane Hr receptor, Ptc, which is the key element of the Hh signal transduction pathway.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the zyxin-Ptc2 interaction is an evolutionarily conserved mechanism of the Hh pathway regulation, which can occur via both the LIM domains of zyxin and juxtamembranous domains of Ptc2.
zyxin is a new component of the Hh pathway.
the cytoskeletal proteins zyxin and zyxin-like proteins are involved in the regulation of the Hedgehog (and probably WNT) signaling pathways.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the interaction between the cytoskeletal zyxin protein and Ptc2, the Hh receptor in Xenopus laeivs, is determined by the second LIM domains of zyxin and by the C-terminal juxtamembranous fragment of the cytoplasmic region of Ptc2.
zyxin may play a key role in the regulation of the Hedgehog (HH) signaling pathway.
zyxin may act as a negative regulator of Hh signaling.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Hh receptor Ptc2 is a cytoplasmic protein, which interacts with cytoskeletal proteins, including zyxin, and is involved in the formation and functioning of the cytoskeleton.
zyxin may play a role in the regulation of Hh signaling by modulating the activity of Ptc.
zyxin, a cytoskeletal protein, is involved in the regulation of the Hedgehog signaling pathway, and this regulation is achieved through the interaction between zyzin and the Hb receptor, Ptc.
